logged_in_page = <Page url='https://app-develop.habitnu.com/app/profile'>

    def test_profile_contact_edit_network_and_reset(logged_in_page):
        page = logged_in_page
        creds = config.get_login_credentials()
        _, token = createUserSession(BASE_URL, creds["webUsernameProfileAutomation"], creds["webUserPasswordProfileAutomation"])
        LoginPage(page).loginBy_skippingUI(f"{WEB_URL}/", token, "app/profile")
        profile = ProfilePage(page)
        events = []
        started = datetime.datetime.now()
    
        def stamp():
            return f"{(datetime.datetime.now() - started).total_seconds():.2f}s"
    
        page.on("request", lambda r: events.append(f"{stamp()} REQ {r.method} {urlparse(r.url).path}") if "/api/" in r.url else None)
        page.on("response", lambda r: events.append(f"{stamp()} RES {r.status} {r.request.method} {urlparse(r.url).path}") if "/api/" in r.url else None)
        profile.open_profile_details(WEB_URL)
        events.append(f"{stamp()} --- details open")
        profile.page.locator(ProfilePage.CARD_EDIT_BUTTON.format(card=ProfilePage.CONTACT_CARD)).click()
        events.append(f"{stamp()} --- edit clicked")
        for field in ("phone", "addressLine2"):
            field_input = profile.card_input(ProfilePage.CONTACT_CARD, field)
            samples = []
            for _ in range(8):
                samples.append(str(len(field_input.input_value())))
                page.wait_for_timeout(250)
            events.append(f"{stamp()} {field} length after edit: {','.join(samples)}")
            field_input.fill("")
            samples = []
            for _ in range(12):
                samples.append(str(len(field_input.input_value())))
                page.wait_for_timeout(250)
            events.append(f"{stamp()} {field} length after fill(''): {','.join(samples)}")
        profile.cancel_card(ProfilePage.CONTACT_CARD)
